canonical_example.text: ¡Ay! ¡Acabas de pisarme el pie!
canonical_example.translation: Ow! You just stepped on my foot!

canonical_example.text: ¡Ay! Me han robado todo.
canonical_example.translation: Oh dear! All my things have been stolen.

canonical_example.text: ¡Ay! Me asustaste.
canonical_example.translation: Jeez! You scared me.

canonical_example.text: ¡Ay! ¡Cómo duele!
canonical_example.translation: Ouch! That really hurts!

canonical_example.text: Su ay se oyó en todo el recinto.
canonical_example.translation: His cry could be heard everywhere.

canonical_example.text: De repente, el perro soltó un ay de dolor.
canonical_example.translation: All of a sudden, the dog let out a painful moan.
